module(name = "dagger-example")

maven = use_extension("@rules_jvm_external//:extensions.bzl", "maven")
maven.install(
    name = "maven_rules_kotlin_example",
    artifacts = [
        "com.google.dagger:dagger:2.57.2",

        "org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-metadata-jvm:2.4.21",
    ],
    lock_file = "//:maven_install.json",
)
maven.install(
    name = "unlocked",
    artifacts = [
        "org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-reflect:2.4.21",
    ],
)
use_repo(maven, "maven_rules_kotlin_example", "unlocked")
